scientific_integrity: Exact analytic inequalities and a limiting-law proof; finite simulations and quadrature are corroborative only. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Origin-symmetric planar convex bases only, with apex above the symmetry center; fixed-perimeter upper extremum is degenerate and unattained among full-dimensional bases; quantified rigidity constant not optimized; independent validation not performed.
title: Sharp base-avoiding plane sections of finite convex cones
